readiness_formula.name: weighted_state_score_v1
readiness_formula.description: Planning readiness % is DERIVED: 100 * sum(importance_weight_i * state_score_i) / sum(importance_weight_i), computed per area and overall. Do not hand-edit % upward.

state_score._pending_family_rule: PHYSICAL_PENDING/HUMAN_PENDING/EXTERNAL_PENDING/STANDARD_PENDING/OWNER_DECISION_PENDING score 0.70 only if digital_prep_complete=true; else 0.10 (early residual — intentionally below IMPLEMENTED 0.35 so physical/commercial cannot inflate from incomplete prep).

importance_weight.note: Documentation-only rows cannot dominate. IMPLEMENTED (0.35) is intentionally far below DIGITALLY_VALIDATED (0.70).
